Meanwhile, Technology and Real Estate maintain strong momentum profiles, keeping them firmly in the upper echelon of the market.

In contrast, rotational shifts are actively reshaping the mid-tier. Basic Materials has emerged as a rapid mover, jumping three ranks over the last five sessions, while Utilities ticked up one spot. This upward movement comes at the direct expense of Financials and Consumer Defensives, both of which fell two spots in the rankings. * **Financials and Defensives Slipping:** Financials (rank 8, momentum 0.567) and Consumer Defensive (rank 7, momentum 0.300) are the biggest losers over the last five sessions, both dropping 2 spots.
* **Technology Holding High Ground:** Technology is the second-strongest momentum leader at 0.700, maintaining its YTD rank of 2.
* **Persistent Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.067, rank 11) and Communication Services (momentum 0.150, rank 10) continue to show severe relative weakness.

## Divergences
* **Basic Materials Early-Warning:** Basic Materials exhibits an emerging divergence, with its rank jumping 3 spots in 5 days to rank 5, even though its overall momentum score remains low at 0.48.
* **Fragile Healthcare Green:** Healthcare is flagged as a fragile all-green sector; despite its positive performance across all timeframes, a low agreement score of 0.44 points to an unstable rank.
